EmailTemplate.description: Template informing student of eligibility for direct admission into BSN and potential scholarship updates. Inserts user's name
EmailTemplate.name: CONHI DA Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing & Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Arizona State University received your updated high school transcripts and/or test scores, and has two important updates for you:
1. You are now eligible for direct admission into the BSN Nursing program (the traditional prelicensure clinical nursing program). 2. Your scholarship amount may have been updated.
Direct admission into the BSN Nursing program: Like many nursing programs, Arizona State University has limited space. Students can move into the upper-division clinical program through one of two designated pathways. One of these pathways is direct admission. If you are a first-time freshman, you can be awarded direct admission based on your high school GPA or class rank, and performance on the SAT or ACT. Earning direct admission status means you are guaranteed placement in the upper-division clinical nursing program as long as you meet the continuing eligibility criteria during your first two years at ASU (requirements outlined in the Traditional BSN major map at https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/majorinfo/ASU00/NUNURDBSN/undergrad/false).
Helpful articles:
What is direct admission in the College of Nursing and Health Innovation? https://asu.secure.force.com/kb/articles/FAQ/What-is-Direct-Admission-in-the-College-of-Nursing-Health-Innovation
What is the difference between nursing and community health? https://asu.secure.force.com/kb/articles/FAQ/What-is-the-Difference-Between-Nursing-and-Community-Health/?q=community+health&l=en_US&fs=Search&pn=1
Scholarships Verify your scholarship amount in My ASU (https://my.asu.edu) under the Finances tab along the black menu bar. You may also visit the scholarship estimator (https://scholarships.asu.edu/estimator) to determine the amount of scholarship money you may be eligible to receive.
Next Steps You must confirm that you would like to change your major to BSN Nursing by responding to this email, contacting us at asu.bsn@asu.edu or 602-496-0937.
We look forward to hearing from you. Sincerely,
{!User.Name} College of Nursing and Health Innovation Recruitment and Admissions Arizona State University 550 North 3rd Street | Phoenix, AZ 85004 602-496-0937 asu.bsn@asu.edu
If you need any additional information or have questions, please reply to this email.
